summary: Temporary danger area EGD496A activated near EGTT, up to 1,300 ft above sea level, for drone operations beyond visual line of sight.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD496A ACTIVATED. AIP SUP 108/2026
REFERS. BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI
THE TDA. A SPECIAL USE AIRSPACE ACTIVITY INFORMATION SERVICE
(SUAAIS) WILL BE AVBL FM ANGLIA RADAR 128.925MHZ OR 125.275MHZ OR
LONDON INFO 125.475MHZ. FOR INFO AND BOOKING CTC
OPS(AT)FLYLOGIX.COM OR 07784 546062. AR-2026-7404/16.
